audience: online shop owners and marketers who keep leads, products and orders in MailBluster

useCases.title: Look up a lead by email
useCases.text: The AI gets one lead by email address and shows name, custom fields, timezone, subscribed and opt-in status, tags and dates.

useCases.title: Add a new lead or update an existing one
useCases.text: The AI adds a lead, which is not subscribed to email unless you say the person gave consent, or changes a lead's name, custom fields, tags or timezone.

useCases.title: Add a custom lead field
useCases.text: The AI lists the custom lead fields with their merge tags and creates a new one. This changes the data model of the brand but sends nothing.

useCases.title: Review order records with their totals
useCases.text: The AI lists order records with currency, total price, customer lead and line items, and reads one order. These are tracking records only.

useCases.title: Check product records or register and rename one
useCases.text: The AI lists the product records used for order tracking, reads one, registers a new product with your own id and name, or renames a product.

useCases.title: Record an order or correct an order record
useCases.text: The AI records an order as a tracking record, with no payment and no email. It can also change an order's campaign, currency, total or items.
